description: The Stacked Area Chart is ideal for showing how the composition of a total changes over time. It supports various stacking modes (standard, 100%, streamgraph) and ordering options to reveal insights in your time series data. It features multiple stacking modes such as Standard, 100%, and Streamgraph, combined with flexible sorting and ordering of layers. The visual also offers smooth curve interpolation options and smart labeling for clear identification of area segments.
